Game Overview

Mini Putt Garden is a sports title where tackle a delightful mini-golf adventure in lush gardens, where strategic precision meets challenging obstacles. Master the art of the perfect putt with intuitive controls, aiming for the leaderboard. Craft expert angles, refine your stroke, and outsmart tricky courses to achieve the ultimate golfing satisfaction. Can you conquer the greens?
